# JXL import fixtures

`opaque.jxl` and `transparent.jxl` are generated test images, encoded losslessly
with @jsquash/jxl 1.3.0 (effort 1, quality 100). Both are 1280 × 720 pixels,
filled with sRGB RGBA (240, 80, 32, 255). The transparent image has a 40-pixel
transparent border. No third-party artwork is included.
